title: Effect of Glycemic Load on Body Composition
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare the effects of diets with different glycemic load (GL) on body composition and biochemical markers in overweight and obese subjects during a 12-month period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Overweight or obese adults

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who are pregnant or have diabetes, cancer, psychiatric disorders or physical disabilities
